## BuyFlow Gmail Targeted SHADOW Test
Fetches exactly one Gmail message by message ID.

**Read-only Gmail fetch. No labels. No drafts. No sends. No BuyFlow writes.**

Call: `GET /webhook/buyflow-gmail-targeted-test?message_id=<GMAIL_ID>`

Flow: Webhook → validate ID → Gmail Get Message → normalize → safe empty candidate placeholder → Agent+Critic → SHADOW audit response.
